{{Quote|Someone has just accessed the main computer in a forward bay command office.|P-RC3|<ref name="DSn">[[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']]</ref>}}
'''Docking Control Room 327''' was the control room overlooking [[Docking Bay 327/Legends|Docking Bay 327]] on the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]]. It was helmed by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Gantry officer/Legends|gantry officer]] [[Pol Treidum/Legends|Pol Treidum]] and a [[Unidentified gantry officer|gantry officer]].

==Description==
The control room was located along the equatorial trench of the first Death Star, next to Docking Bay 327. A bump-out contained a computer, next to which was a [[Viewport/Legends|viewport]] that looked into the hangar below. On one side of the room was a small closet and the door.<ref name="Episode IV" /> In one corner of the room was a security camera.<ref name="DSn" />

==History==
{{Quote|Now, look, don't get any funny ideas. The old man wants us to wait right here.|Han Solo to Luke Skywalker|<ref name="Episode IV" />}}
[[File:PolTreidum.png|thumb|left|250px|Pol Treidum manning the control room]]
Treidum and another officer had been operating the control room in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], during the arrival of the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] which had been pulled in by [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]]. After several long minutes of no word from his [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] below, he manned the comm and requested that [[TK-421/Legends|TK-421]] return to his post. A trooper appeared and signaled a helmet problem. Treidum acknowledged and opened the doors to the control room, but was knocked out by [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], after which his partner was shot. The control room then fell into hands of the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]], as well as [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]]. As the droids located the tractor beam control, Solo and Skywalker formulated a plan for escape, and upon hearing of [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] detained on board, decided to visit [[Detention Block AA-23/Legends|Detention Block AA-23]] to [[Rescue of Princess Leia/Legends|rescue her]]. The droids stayed behind while the rest headed separate ways throughout the battlestation.<ref name="Episode IV" /> Unbeknownst to them, they were being watched over a security camera by Death Star librarian [[Atour Riten]], who sympathized with the intruders and supplied the [[Turbolift/Legends|lifts]] to the detention block with the proper egress protocol.<ref name="DSn" />

The control room door eventually was opened by stormtroopers, who met the droids hiding in the closet. C-3PO diverted the stormtroopers who left one to stand guard in the room. The droids promptly left and relocated to a computer terminal in the hanger itself.<ref name="Episode IV" />

Eventually, the control room, along with the rest of the Death Star, was destroyed during the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="Episode IV" />
